title: Threats
meaning: Words, messages or gestures saying someone will hurt you, others or your belongings, or that make you fear for your safety.
examples_and_warning_signs: "I will hurt you" in person or online
Mentions of a weapon, place or time
Threats to share private information unless you do something
steps: Take every threat seriously. Do not face the person alone.
Tell a trusted adult right away.
Save messages or write down exact words, date and place.
Do not reply or give in to demands.
Online threats can be reported at cybercrime.gov.in with an adult's help.
seek_immediate_help: The threat names a weapon, place or time
You feel in danger now: call 112
